messages:
nina-sales: Rivergate signed an NDA and asked for a 1-day perf POC next Fri. Target: sustain 300 qps with avg completion ~800 tokens, p95 < 200ms. They want a short written runbook and a committed-cost estimate to compare Dedicated vs in-house.

 devon-eng: doable. Need exact prompt/completion split, streaming preference, TLS/mTLS, and whether user data counts as PII. Also prefer to run a primary model + quant fallback to show cost tradeoffs.

 maya-ml: propose Redwood-22B optimized as primary, RedCloud-13B-quant fallback. Test mix: 65% short (50-180 tokens), 25% medium (300-600), 10% long (900-1.2k). We'll include 10% adversarial long prompts to exercise tails.

 alex-ops: Ops plan: reserve Fri 08:00-13:00 UTC (includes priming and debrief). Infra: 3x A100-80GB workers, continuous batching, 3 workers behind LB. Priming: 10m with 5k prefixes. We'll provide a priming curl snippet.

 nina-sales: Rivergate also asked about 90-day audit logs, BYOK, and region pinning to eu-west. Are those available for Dedicated?

 sec-bot: BYOK and region pinning supported on Dedicated/Private. 90-day retention can be enabled for POC audit logs; anything longer requires contract addendum. SCIM/SAML require Private for full SSO automation.

 devon-eng: routing: failover to 13B-quant at 95th latency breach; enable streaming to improve perceived latency. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, kv-hit, and model-variant per request.

 maya-ml: small smoke first: 30m at 100 qps, then ramp 20m to 300 qps, 60m steady if they want longer. We'll run eval checks pre/post to detect regressions.

 alex-ops: priming snippet:

 ```bash
 curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.example/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME" \
  --data-binary @prefixes_5k.jsonl
 ```

 devon-eng: rough GPU-hours calc: 3x A100 sustaining 300 qps for 1h ~ 3 GPU-hours. Monthly committed to support that sustained in prod depends on expected sustained minutes/day; I'll post a table tomorrow with GPU-hours -> committed price. Hosted token pricing will be orders of magnitude higher for sustained loads.

 nina-sales: Action items: (1) I'll send Rivergate IPs and SSO contact today. (2) Alex reserve pool Fri 08-13 UTC. (3) Devon/Maya finalize routing and priming list by EOD tomorrow. (4) Devon to post GPU-hour -> price note.

 alex-ops: Created infra ticket INF-4721 and tentative calendar invite. Tagging @devon-eng @maya-ml.

 nina-sales: thanks all 389 :rocket:
